<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

from collections import deque
def clusters(fr,ch):
    aa=fr.ascii.split('\n'); s=set(); o=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(aa):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c==ch and (i,j) not in s:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); s.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(aa) and 0<=nc<len(aa[nr]) and aa[nr][nc]==ch and (nr,nc) not in s:
                            s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                o.append((min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc),len(pix)))
    return o

# Probe current state: click C, D, E and B's old target; observe outline + greens after each
for name,(r,c) in {'C':(19,36),'D':(25,42),'E':(37,42),'Btarget':(19,12)}.items():
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ol=[cl for cl in clusters(current_frame,'g') if cl[4]<12]
    print(name,'outline',ol,'greens',clusters(current_frame,'N'),'key','p' in current_frame.ascii)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

from collections import deque
def clusters(fr,ch):
    aa=fr.ascii.split('\n'); s=set(); o=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(aa):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c==ch and (i,j) not in s:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); s.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(aa) and 0<=nc<len(aa[nr]) and aa[nr][nc]==ch and (nr,nc) not in s:
                            s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                o.append((min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc),len(pix)))
    return o
